description:
Tighten parent guidance so nonblocking orchestration does not invite the parent to concurrently edit delegated scope, while preserving Beadwork's parent-owned ticket lifecycle.

## Background

Core minions guidance says `orchestrate` is background work that should not block the parent, but does not define what work the parent may safely continue. Beadwork run mode tells the parent to orchestrate but does not state strongly enough that it is a manager-only loop. Dogfood feedback showed parent-induced semantic churn when the parent and children independently modified the same problem.

## Required guidance

### General minions: cooperative sidecar

- Use sidecar orchestration only for slices independent of the parent's continuing work.
- Once scope is delegated, the parent must not edit that delegated scope while the child is live; message or halt the child instead.
- The parent may continue user interaction, inspection, planning, or non-overlapping work.
- Path intent and overlap notices remain advisory, not locks.
- A parent turn ending while children run is normal, but the parent must not represent delegated work as complete.

### Beadwork `/bw run`: manager-only

- Parent refreshes ready/show, starts issues, composes complete tasks, dispatches, adjudicates handoffs, launches required independent reviews, dispatches fixes, and keeps ready work in flight.
- Parent does not implement a delegated ticket concurrently with its live child.
- Children do not start/close/reopen tickets; parent-owned mutation boundary remains.
- Implementation child tasks must explicitly require an atomic ticket-scoped commit and returned commit SHA. Follow repository instructions to stage only owned files; no broad staging.
- Reviewer children start only after the implementer settles and inspect the named SHA/ticket with `git show`, not the whole dirty checkout.
- Settlement remains evidence, not acceptance or ticket closure.

## Scope / ownership

- minions tool promptGuidelines, `skill.ts`, README and concise learning copy
- Beadwork `prompt.ts` standing run appendix, `/bw run` injected prompt copy if required, and prompt/golden tests
- terminology must use canonical `agent`, not the removed `role` selector

## Explicit non-goals

- Do not add a group operating-mode field in this epic.
- Do not infer behavior from opaque `domain.source`.
- Do not import minions runtime/AgentTree into Beadwork.
- Do not add locks, edit interception, commit detection, worktrees, polling, or a child result schema.
- Do not make children mutate Beadwork tickets.

## Acceptance behavior

- A parent given generic orchestrate guidance can distinguish safe non-overlapping sidecar work from unsafe concurrent editing.
- `/bw run` prompt clearly establishes manager-only behavior and the implementation→commit SHA→independent review chain.
- Prompt tests lock the negative constraints without freezing incidental prose.
- Existing ticket/scope/none review-policy branches and taskType next questions remain correct.

## Tests and validation

Update focused minions skill/prompt tests and Beadwork prompt/in-process orchestration assertions. Avoid giant incidental snapshots; assert the operative boundaries and closed doors. Run scoped lint/test/typecheck for both packages. Commit atomically with this issue id.
title: Define sidecar and Beadwork manager-only orchestration boundaries
